You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many employees oversee the entire company? The company has 50 employees. 20% of the employees are management. Only 30% of the management employees oversee the entire company. The company has 10 departments. Management employees are distributed equally among the departments.
